summary: Demo Bank plans to introduce an end-to-end digital consumer loan product within its mobile banking application for payroll customers, offering financing up to 1,000,000 ALL. Eligible applicants can configure their preferred amount and term, preview the calculated monthly instalment, and submit for instant automated credit evaluation. Upon automated approval and verification that the borrower has a satisfactory credit history, loan funds must be disbursed directly into the customer's current account within the same day.

business_rules.rule: Only customers who receive their salary into Demo Bank are eligible to apply for the consumer loan.
business_rules.source_quote: Customers whose salary is paid into Demo Bank can apply for a loan up to 1,000,000 ALL.

business_rules.rule: The maximum loan principal amount that a customer can request is 1,000,000 ALL.
business_rules.source_quote: Customers whose salary is paid into Demo Bank can apply for a loan up to 1,000,000 ALL.

business_rules.rule: The mobile application must calculate and display the monthly repayment instalment to the customer based on their selected loan amount and term prior to submission.
business_rules.source_quote: The customer chooses the amount and the term, sees the monthly instalment and submits the application.

business_rules.rule: Loan evaluation and credit decisioning must be performed automatically without human intervention.
business_rules.source_quote: The decision should be automatic and the money should arrive in the customer's current account the same day.

business_rules.rule: Following an approval decision, the approved loan amount must be disbursed into the customer's current account on the same day.
business_rules.source_quote: The decision should be automatic and the money should arrive in the customer's current account the same day.

business_rules.rule: Applicants with a bad credit history must be declined for the loan.
business_rules.source_quote: Customers with a bad credit history should not get the loan.

open_questions.question: How is salary domiciliation verified (e.g., minimum consecutive monthly salary payments, transaction narrative codes, minimum salary amount)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without a strict technical definition, non-payroll customers or one-off transfer recipients could access the loan or eligible payroll clients could be falsely blocked.

open_questions.question: What are the minimum and maximum allowable loan terms (in months) and what is the minimum loan amount?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Developers and QA cannot constrain the tenure and amount input fields or sliders in the mobile UI.

open_questions.question: What interest rate model (fixed vs. variable, APR formula) and fee structure (origination fee, insurance) are used to compute the monthly instalment?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Instalment calculation logic cannot be built without agreed financial formulas and fee schedules.

open_questions.question: What constitutes a 'bad credit history' (e.g., local credit bureau score cut-off, past due days, write-offs, internal Demo Bank delinquency)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Automated underwriting cannot be programmed without explicit binary decision rules or threshold credit scores.

open_questions.question: How and when is customer consent obtained to query the external credit bureau register?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Querying a credit bureau without explicit, auditable customer consent breaches data protection and banking secrecy laws.

open_questions.question: What digital contract signing mechanism (e.g., SMS OTP, qualified electronic signature) will be used to execute the credit agreement?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Disbursing loan funds without a legally enforceable digital contract creates severe legal unenforceability risks.

open_questions.question: What is the exact cut-off time for same-day disbursement, and what fallback process runs if payment queues stall near midnight?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Operations and core banking could fail the same-day service-level agreement if requests are submitted late at night or during system downtime.

open_questions.question: What specific messaging, cooling-off guidance, or adverse action notices should be displayed to rejected customers?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Vague rejection screens damage customer experience and may violate local consumer credit disclosure obligations.

risks.description: Non-compliance with national consumer lending regulations if mandatory pre-contractual disclosures (SECCI/standard European consumer credit overview equivalent), APR, and total cost of credit are omitted before submission.
Automated disbursement of credit without obtaining legally binding consent for credit bureau checks or digital contract execution, rendering debts unrecoverable.
High credit default and non-performing loan rates if debt-to-income (DTI) ratio checks and credit bureau delinquency thresholds are poorly calibrated.
Account takeover and identity fraud leading to fraudulent loan origination and rapid fund exfiltration via compromised mobile app credentials.
Disbursement settlement bottlenecks or core banking end-of-day batch processing failures preventing the fulfilment of the same-day disbursement commitment.
Failure, high latency, or timeout of external credit bureau integration causing stalled automated decisions and poor user experience.
Inaccurate salary detection due to missing employer payment flags or payroll reference data corruption resulting in false eligibility decisions.

stories.i_want: to configure my loan amount and term in the mobile app and see my monthly instalment
stories.so_that: I can evaluate repayment affordability before submitting my loan application
stories.source_quote: The customer chooses the amount and the term, sees the monthly instalment and submits the application.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer is logged into the mobile app and qualifies as a salary-domiciled client per Q-1
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer accesses the consumer loan application screen
acceptance_criteria.then: the system permits amount selection up to 1,000,000 ALL and term selection within allowable boundaries defined in Q-2

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer changes the loan amount or loan term within valid ranges
acceptance_criteria.then: the mobile app dynamically updates and displays the recalculated monthly instalment using the approved rate formula defined in Q-3

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer attempts to request an amount greater than 1,000,000 ALL
acceptance_criteria.then: the system blocks entry, restricts the field to the 1,000,000 ALL maximum limit, and displays an informative validation message

stories.i_want: the mobile app to evaluate my salary eligibility and credit history automatically upon submission
stories.so_that: I receive an immediate loan decision without visiting a branch or waiting for manual underwriting
stories.source_quote: Customers whose salary is paid into Demo Bank can apply for a loan up to 1,000,000 ALL. The decision should be automatic and the money should arrive in the customer's current account the same day. Customers with a bad credit history should not get the loan.

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer whose salary is not paid into Demo Bank per Q-1 criteria
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer attempts to access or submit the loan application
acceptance_criteria.then: the system automatically declines or blocks the application and presents an eligibility explanation per Q-8

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer who meets salary requirements and submits a completed loan application with consent per Q-5
acceptance_criteria.when: automated underwriting evaluates credit bureau and internal records against bad credit criteria per Q-4
acceptance_criteria.then: the system returns an immediate decision without manual underwriter intervention

acceptance_criteria.given: an applicant whose credit bureau or internal records indicate a bad credit history per Q-4
acceptance_criteria.then: the application is automatically rejected and the status is presented to the customer per Q-8

stories.as_a: Demo Bank customer with an approved loan application
stories.i_want: the loan funds disbursed directly to my current account on the same day
stories.so_that: I can access the requested funds immediately via my mobile account
stories.source_quote: The decision should be automatic and the money should arrive in the customer's current account the same day.

acceptance_criteria.given: the loan application has received an automated approval and digital contract execution is completed per Q-6
acceptance_criteria.when: the disbursement process executes within the same-day operational cut-off window defined in Q-7
acceptance_criteria.then: the principal amount is credited into the customer's Demo Bank current account on the same calendar day

acceptance_criteria.given: loan funds have successfully posted to the customer's current account
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer views their account summary in the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.then: the updated current account balance reflects the disbursed funds and a confirmation notification is displayed

uat_cases.title: Verify loan simulation and instalment display within permitted boundaries
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer is logged into mobile app, has verified salary domiciliation per Q-1, and is on the loan application screen.
steps: Select loan amount equal to 500,000 ALL.
Select loan term equal to 24 months (within Q-2 boundary).
Observe the displayed monthly instalment value.
uat_cases.expected_result: The mobile app allows amount and term selection within Q-2 parameters and dynamically recalculates and displays the monthly instalment matching the financial formula defined in Q-3.

uat_cases.title: Verify amount input boundary restriction at 1,000,000 ALL
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer is logged into mobile app and has valid salary domiciliation per Q-1.
steps: Attempt to enter 1,000,001 ALL in the loan amount field.
Attempt to adjust slider above 1,000,000 ALL if slider control is present.
uat_cases.expected_result: The app prevents input above 1,000,000 ALL, displays a validation error indicating maximum limit, and successfully accepts 1,000,000 ALL as valid.

uat_cases.title: Verify application rejection for non-salary customer
uat_cases.preconditions: User is logged into mobile app with an active Demo Bank current account but has no qualifying salary deposits per Q-1.
steps: Navigate to the consumer loan section in the mobile app.
Attempt to start or submit a loan application.
uat_cases.expected_result: The application cannot proceed; system identifies lack of salary domiciliation and displays the explanatory message defined in Q-8.

uat_cases.title: Verify automated rejection for applicant with bad credit history
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has valid salary domiciliation per Q-1, but credit bureau profile contains delinquency records meeting bad credit criteria in Q-4.
steps: Configure loan amount 200,000 ALL and term 12 months.
Grant required credit check consent per Q-5.
uat_cases.expected_result: The decision is processed automatically without manual routing, the application is rejected due to credit history per Q-4, and the rejection screen per Q-8 is shown.

uat_cases.title: Verify automated approval and same-day current account disbursement
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has valid salary domiciliation per Q-1, clean credit history passing Q-4 criteria, and submits before same-day cut-off per Q-7.
steps: Configure loan for 300,000 ALL and 12-month tenure.
Submit application with consent per Q-5.
Check Demo Bank current account balance and transaction statement on the same calendar day.
uat_cases.expected_result: Automated decision returns approval instantly; 300,000 ALL is credited to the customer's current account on the same day, balance is increased accordingly, and confirmation notification is visible in app.
